.claude/skills/mise/SKILL.md:
---
name: mise
description: Runs this repo's mise tasks and edits its mise config — use it before running, adding or changing a task, a tool pin, an env value or an alias.
---

# mise

This repo runs on mise: it pins the tools, holds the env values and runs the
tasks.

## Running tasks

- Run every task as `mise run <task>`; discover them with `mise tasks`. Tasks
  differ per repo, so never assume a task name the table below does not list.
- Work locally under `MISE_ENV=dev`. `setup:all` refuses an unset `MISE_ENV`:
  `MISE_ENV=dev mise run setup:all`.
- `code:check:all`, `code:lint:all`, `code:format:all`, `setup:ai:all` and
  `setup:deps:<verb>:all` run every subtask beside them; add a step by adding a
  subtask file, never by editing an `all` task.

## Where things live

- `.config/miserc.toml` and `.config/mise.toml` hold settings and top-level
  keys only.
- `.config/mise/conf.d/<folder>/mise.toml` holds a folder's tools, env values,
  tasks and aliases for every environment, `mise.<env>.toml` for one (`dev`,
  `ci`, `test`). `_base/` and `ai/` are stackgen's, one folder per pack is the
  pack's, and a folder named for a project is the repo's own.
- `.config/mise/tasks/` holds the file-based tasks; `_scripts/` there is the
  library they share.
- `mise.local.toml` is this machine's, gitignored and never committed.
- stackgen's tool-config renders `_base/`, `ai/`, each pack's folder and the
  `all` tasks; a hand edit there is shown as a change on its next run. Put the
  repo's own pins and values in a folder of its own.

## Adding a tool

Pin it in exactly one folder. In `mise.dev.toml` write `version = "latest"`;
in a file CI loads (`mise.toml`, `mise.ci.toml`, `mise.test.toml`) write the
exact version. Then run `mise install` — never a bare `mise use`, which writes
the top-level config this layout keeps settings-only.

## Tasks

| Task | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `code:all` | Check, format, lint and security-scan all code |
| `code:check:all` | Run the repo's checks — every code:check subtask |
| `code:count` | Count lines of code |
| `code:format:all` | Format the repo's files — every code:format subtask |
| `code:format:dprint` | Format the repo's files with dprint |
| `code:format:shell` | Format the repo's shell scripts with shfmt |
| `code:git-config` | Validate the local git-config carries the forge identity and signing setup |
| `code:graph` | Refresh the graphify knowledge graph, run by the graphify-refresh post-commit hook (code only, no LLM) |
| `code:lint:all` | Lint the repo's files — every code:lint subtask |
| `code:lint:house` | Lint the repo with the house linter |
| `code:lint:shell` | Lint the repo's shell scripts with shellcheck |
| `code:lint:workflows` | Lint the repo's GitHub workflows with actionlint |
| `code:merge:develop` | Land a feature branch on develop — merge it, or open a pull request (MERGE_MODEL_DEVELOP) |
| `code:merge:main` | Land develop on main — merge it, or open a pull request (MERGE_MODEL_MAIN) |
| `code:precommit` | Run the commit hooks over your changed files |
| `code:sec` | Security scan the repo |
| `code:worktrees` | List git worktrees across this repo and every member |
| `init` | Initialize mise tasks |
| `setup:ai:all` | Reconcile the AI tooling — every setup:ai subtask |
| `setup:ai:base` | Check for the workflow plugin, then update every marketplace and plugin |
| `setup:all` | Set up everything this repo needs on your machine |
| `setup:deps:all` | Install and refresh this repo's package-manager dependencies |
| `setup:deps:audit:all` | Report known vulnerabilities in the dependency trees — every setup:deps:audit subtask |
| `setup:deps:cleanup:all` | Delete installed dependencies and package-manager caches — every setup:deps:cleanup subtask |
| `setup:deps:install:all` | Install this repo's dependencies — every setup:deps:install subtask |
| `setup:deps:outdated:all` | Report dependencies that have moved on — every setup:deps:outdated subtask |
| `setup:deps:upgrade:all` | Move the lockfiles forward within their declared ranges — every setup:deps:upgrade subtask |
| `setup:mise` | Setup MISE: install the pinned versions, reshim & doctor |
| `setup:precommit` | Install pre-commit hooks; skips a foreign hook manager with a warning |
| `setup:secrets` | Install and configure this repo's secret manager |
| `setup:worktree` | Initialise a fresh git worktree (lighter than setup:all) |
.config/git-conventional-commits.yaml:
---
# The commit convention: the `commit-msg` hook enforces it, and the changelog reads it.

convention:
  # Ten types, and no more.
  commitTypes:
    - feat # a new capability a user can observe. Bumps the minor version.
    - fix # a defect in a shipped capability, not in one added this branch.
    - perf # same behaviour, measurably cheaper. Say what was measured.
    - refactor # neither fixes nor adds — including pure formatting changes.
    - revert # undoes an earlier commit; name it in the body.
    - test # tests only. A test written alongside a fix belongs to the fix.
    - ops # tooling, config, dependencies, CI, release mechanics.
    - docs # prose: README, guides, specifications, design documents.
    - merge # a merge commit. Written by the merge task, rarely by hand.
    - wip # work in progress. Never survives a merge; excluded from notes.

  # One scope per project id.
  # A scope that stops existing stays in stackgen.yaml's `scopes`: deleting it invalidates its commits.
  commitScopes:
    - web
    - api

  featureCommitTypes:
    - feat

  # A repo that namespaces its tags per component narrows this to that prefix.
  releaseTagGlobPattern: "*"

changelog:
  # test, ops, docs, merge and wip are deliberately absent from the notes.
  commitTypes:
    - feat
    - fix
    - perf
    - refactor
    - revert

  includeInvalidCommits: false

  # Also catches `wip` commits written before the convention.
  commitIgnoreRegexPattern: '^[wW][iI][pP]\b'

  headlines:
    feat: Features
    fix: Bug Fixes
    perf: Performance Improvements
    refactor: Refactors
    revert: Reverts
    breakingChange: BREAKING CHANGES

  # The changelog links, from `origin`.
  commitUrl: https://github.com/acme/widget/commit/%commit%
  commitRangeUrl: https://github.com/acme/widget/compare/%from%...%to%?diff=split
  issueRegexPattern: "#[0-9]+"
  issueUrl: https://github.com/acme/widget/issues/%issue%
.config/mise/conf.d/_base/mise.ci.toml:
[settings]
# mise's bundled Node release-key import (gpg --import) fails on the Ubuntu CI
# runner's gpg with "no valid OpenPGP data found", aborting `mise install`. The
# same mise version verifies fine on macOS, so it is a mise-on-Linux bug, not a
# version issue — pinning does not help. Disable only the gpg signature check in
# CI; the Node tarball is still SHA256-checksum verified (node.verify). Local dev
# (mise.toml) keeps full gpg verification.
node.gpg_verify = false
.config/mise/conf.d/_base/mise.dev.toml:
# The developer laptop's base — loaded when MISE_ENV includes dev. Dev tools stay on latest.

[settings]
# Python, pipx, uv settings
# every pipx: tool installs through uv
pipx.uvx            = true
python.compile      = false
python.uv_venv_auto = "create|source"

# mise's pipx backend installs through uv, and uv needs a Python >= 3.10 to lock graphifyy's dependencies.
[tools.python]
version = "latest"

[tools.uv]
depends = [ "python" ]
version = "latest"

[tools."pre-commit"]
depends = [ "python", "uv" ]
uvx     = true
version = "latest"

# OSV Scanner is a tool for scanning open source vulnerabilities.
[tools.osv-scanner]
version = "latest"

# Grype is a vulnerability scanner for container images
# and filesystems
[tools.grype]
version = "latest"

# Gitleaks is a SAST tool for detecting hardcoded secrets like
# passwords, API keys, and tokens in git repositories
[tools.gitleaks]
version = "latest"

# Dprint is a code formatter for various programming languages
[tools.dprint]
version = "latest"

# Taplo is a code formatter for TOML files
[tools.taplo]
depends = [ "dprint" ]
version = "latest"

# Shell and workflow gates: `code:{format,lint}:shell` and `code:lint:workflows`.
[tools.shellcheck]
version = "latest"

[tools.shfmt]
version = "latest"

[tools.actionlint]
version = "latest"

# The house linter, run by `code:lint:house`.
[tools."npm:@askviraj/linter"]
allow_low_downloads = true
version             = "latest"

[shell_alias]
precommit = "mise run code:precommit"
setup     = "mise run setup:all"
worktrees = "mise run code:worktrees"
setup-web = "mise run setup:all --web"
setup-api-x = "mise run setup:all --api-x"

[env]
PRE_COMMIT_HOME = "$HOME/.cache/pre-commit"

# Python (uv)
UV_NO_CACHE          = true
UV_NO_MANAGED_PYTHON = true
UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS  = "never"
.config/mise/conf.d/_base/mise.toml:
# Every repo's base, loaded in every MISE_ENV. A tool is pinned in exactly one conf.d folder.

[settings]
# NodeJS settings
node.compile        = false
npm.package_manager = "pnpm"

# Node has good backward compatibility: node and pnpm stay on latest even where CI loads them.
[tools.node]
version = "latest"

[tools.pnpm]
depends = [ "node" ]
version = "latest"

[tasks.init]
# In the base, not dev: `setup:all` depends on it, and CI needs the task files executable too.
description = "Initialize mise tasks"
dir         = "{{exec(command='git rev-parse --show-toplevel')}}"
hide        = true
run         = "find .config/mise/tasks/ -name '*' -type f -not -path '*/*.env' -exec chmod 755 {} \\;"

[env]
_.path = { path = "node_modules/.bin", tools = true }

# A literal: never derive it at load time, since a linked worktree's folder is named for its branch.
REPO_NAME = "widget"

# `direct` merges locally, `pr` opens a pull request.
MERGE_MODEL_DEVELOP = "direct"
MERGE_MODEL_MAIN    = "pr"

# Member repo paths, space-separated; empty when the members are submodules.
MEMBERS = "apps/web svc/API_x"
.config/mise/conf.d/ai/mise.dev.toml:
# AI Tools
[tools.jq]
version = "latest"

[tools.yq]
version = "latest"

[tools."pipx:mempalace"]
depends = [ "python", "uv" ]
uvx     = true
version = "latest"

[tools."pipx:graphifyy"]
depends = [ "python", "uv" ]
uvx     = true
version = "latest"

[env]
# Mempalace Backend (common across repos)
MEMPALACE_BACKEND               = "qdrant"
MEMPALACE_EMBEDDING_DEVICE      = "auto"
MEMPALACE_EMBEDDING_MODEL       = "minilm"
MEMPALACE_MAX_BACKUPS           = 4
MEMPALACE_MCP_ALLOW_PEER_WRITER = 1
MEMPALACE_MCP_IDLE_HOURS        = 0
MEMPALACE_QDRANT_URL            = "http://127.0.0.1:6333"

# Palace path for storing local data
MEMPALACE_PALACE_PATH = "~/.local/share/mempalace/widget"

#!/usr/bin/env bash

#MISE description="Run the repo's checks — every code:check subtask"
#MISE dir="{{ config_root }}"

#USAGE flag "--debug" help="emit debug logs"
#USAGE arg "[files]" var=#true help="files to check (default: the whole repo)"

set -euo pipefail
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
source "${MISE_PROJECT_ROOT}/.config/mise/tasks/_scripts/helpers"

# Rendered by stackgen tool-config: one call per subtask under code/check/, re-rendered whenever a pack adds or removes one.

print_yellow "code:check: nothing to run — this repo has no code:check:<name> subtask."
.config/mise/tasks/code/format/all:
#!/usr/bin/env bash

#MISE description="Format the repo's files — every code:format subtask"
#MISE dir="{{ config_root }}"

#USAGE flag "--debug" help="emit debug logs"
#USAGE flag "--fix" help="apply fixes"
#USAGE arg "[files]" var=#true help="files to format (default: the whole repo)"

set -euo pipefail
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
source "${MISE_PROJECT_ROOT}/.config/mise/tasks/_scripts/helpers"

# Rendered by stackgen tool-config: one call per subtask under code/format/, re-rendered whenever a pack adds or removes one.

files=()
eval "files+=(${usage_files:-})"

args=()
[[ "${usage_debug:-false}" == "true" ]] && args+=(--debug)
[[ "${usage_fix:-false}" == "true" ]] && args+=(--fix)

mise run code:format:dprint ${args[@]+"${args[@]}"} ${files[@]+"${files[@]}"}

mise run code:format:shell ${args[@]+"${args[@]}"} ${files[@]+"${files[@]}"}

.config/mise/tasks/setup/all:
#!/usr/bin/env bash

#MISE description="Set up everything this repo needs on your machine"
#MISE depends=["init"]

#USAGE flag "--all" help="Also set up every member project"

# One flag per member repo, named by its slug.
#USAGE flag "--web" help="Set up the apps/web project"
#USAGE flag "--api-x" help="Set up the svc/API_x project"

set -euo pipefail
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
source "${MISE_PROJECT_ROOT}/.config/mise/tasks/_scripts/helpers"

# MISE_ENV decides which conf.d files load; guessing it is wrong.
if [ -z "${MISE_ENV:-}" ]; then
  print_error "MISE_ENV is unset. On a developer machine run: MISE_ENV=dev mise run setup:all"
  exit 1
fi

# Idempotent and non-destructive: it installs the pins and moves none.
print_header "Setting up the toolchain ..."
mise run setup:mise

print_header "Setting up secrets ..."
mise run setup:secrets

print_header "Setting up dependencies ..."
mise run setup:deps:all

print_header "Setting up commit hooks ..."
mise run setup:precommit

print_header "Setting up AI tooling ..."
mise run setup:ai:all

# Again: an older installer `setup:ai` runs wires graphify's raw git hooks and merge driver, which this strips.
print_header "Re-checking commit hooks ..."
mise run setup:precommit

# Members only on request — `--all`, or a member's own `--<slug>` — each running its OWN task library
# from inside it, so its own miserc.toml is read. The slug is the member folder's name, slugified as the
# flags above were written; usage exposes `--<slug>` as `usage_<slug>` with `-` read as `_`.
while read -r member; do
  [ -n "$member" ] || continue
  slug="$(basename "$member" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | sed -E 's/[^a-z0-9]+/-/g; s/^-+//; s/-+$//')"
  flag="usage_${slug//-/_}"
  [[ "${usage_all:-false}" == "true" || "${!flag:-false}" == "true" ]] || continue
  print_header "Setting up ${member} ..."
  (cd "${MISE_PROJECT_ROOT}/${member}" && mise run setup:all </dev/null)
done < <(members)

print_header "Setup complete!"
